info.title: Studafy API
info.description:
HTTP API for Studafy.

**Errors.** Every failure is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document. Alongside the standard members it carries `code`, a stable machine-readable error code, and `request_id`, which correlates the failure with server logs and the audit trail. Read `code`, not `title` or `detail` — those are prose and may be localized via `Accept-Language`. 5xx problems never carry a `detail`; quote the `request_id` instead.

**Correlation.** Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header. It is generated by the server and never read from the request.

**Authentication.** Nothing here is authenticated yet. The `bearerAuth` scheme is declared for the endpoints that will use it, but no operation requires it today, and the API exposes no tenant data as a result.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication and authorization endpoints. The JWKS endpoint is public and unauthenticated — clients fetch it to verify access tokens.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes. Never authenticated — an orchestrator has no credentials.

tags.name: ERPNext
tags.description: Inbound webhook ingestion from ERPNext. Authenticated by an HMAC signature over the raw request body, not by a session token.

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: User invitation management. Authenticated. Invitations are bound to an email and role, carry a one-time-use token, and emit an event for email dispatch.

bearerAuth.description: Not yet implemented. No operation requires it, and no code path validates one — this app has no authentication. Declared so the scheme's shape is settled before the first route needs it.

school_id.description: Owning school tenant. Immutable — enforced by a database trigger, not policy.

email.description: Contact address as supplied. Unique per school after normalization.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the user within its school.

email_verified_at.description: Null until the address is verified.

id.description: Primary key. This is the tenant identifier.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the school tenant.

event_id.description: ERPNext's unique id for this delivery. Used to deduplicate redeliveries.

data.description: The ERPNext document. Must carry school_id (or custom_school_id) — the payload is otherwise untenanted and cannot be routed to a tenant.

token.description: One-time-use invitation token (hex-encoded, 256-bit). This is the only time the raw token is returned. Store it securely and pass it to the invitee — it cannot be retrieved later.

role.description: Role to be assigned on acceptance.

email.description: Email address to send the invitation to.

role.description: Role to assign when the invitation is accepted.

expiry_days.description: Number of days until the invitation expires. Defaults to 7. Must be between 1 and 365.

get.description: Reports that the process is alive. Answers unconditionally — it never checks a dependency, because a liveness probe that fails on a downstream outage would have the orchestrator restart a healthy process.

post.description:
Accepts a signed document event from ERPNext, records it for deduplication, enqueues an outbox event, and projects the document into the finance cache.

Deduplicated on (school_id, event_id): redelivering an event already seen answers 200 without re-processing it, so ERPNext's at-least-once delivery is safe to retry.

An event whose doctype/action pair maps to no known event also answers 200 — it is delivered, understood, and deliberately ignored. Answering an error would make ERPNext retry forever.
